title.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）

summary.en: Humans compare answers, a reward model learns their preferences, and RL tunes the model for high reward, leashed by a KL penalty.
summary.zh: 人类比较回答，奖励模型学会他们的偏好，再用强化学习追求高奖励，并用 KL 惩罚拴住模型。

explain.en: RLHF has three steps. First, labellers compare responses to the same prompt and pick the better one. Second, a reward model, usually the SFT model with a scalar head, is trained on these comparisons so that r(x, preferred) > r(x, rejected), using the Bradley–Terry loss −log σ(r_w − r_l). Third, the policy is optimised by reinforcement learning, classically PPO, to maximise r(x, y) − β·KL(π ‖ π_ref), where π_ref is the frozen SFT model. The KL term keeps the policy near fluent, sensible text. Without it the policy finds reward hacks, outputs the reward model overrates, such as padding, flattery or confident nonsense. People find comparing easier than writing perfect answers, which is why preference data scales.
explain.zh: RLHF 分三步。第一，标注员比较同一提示的几个回答，选出更好的。第二，用这些比较训练奖励模型（通常是 SFT 模型加一个标量输出头），使 r(x, 胜者) > r(x, 败者)，损失取 Bradley–Terry 形式 −log σ(r_w − r_l)。第三，用强化学习（经典做法是 PPO）优化策略，最大化 r(x, y) − β·KL(π ‖ π_ref)，π_ref 是冻结的 SFT 模型。KL 项让策略不偏离通顺合理的文本；没有它，策略就会钻奖励模型的空子（奖励投机），比如注水、拍马屁或自信地胡说。比起写出完美答案，人更容易做比较，所以偏好数据容易规模化。

example.en: Prompt: 'Explain DNS to a child.' Answer A uses a phone-book analogy; answer B is a correct but dense summary of the RFC. The labeller prefers A. If the reward model scores r_A = 2.0 and r_B = 0.5, it predicts A wins with probability σ(1.5) ≈ 0.82, a loss of −ln 0.82 ≈ 0.20. Later, in PPO, an answer with reward 3.0 that sits 4.0 nats of KL from the SFT model nets 3.0 − 0.1 × 4.0 = 2.6 at β = 0.1.
example.zh: 提示：“给小孩讲讲 DNS。”回答 A 用电话簿作比喻；回答 B 是正确但晦涩的 RFC 摘要。标注员选 A。若奖励模型打分 r_A = 2.0、r_B = 0.5，它判定 A 胜的概率为 σ(1.5) ≈ 0.82，损失 −ln 0.82 ≈ 0.20。之后的 PPO 中，某回答奖励 3.0，与 SFT 模型的 KL 为 4.0 奈特，取 β = 0.1，净得 3.0 − 0.1 × 4.0 = 2.6。

image.en: A teacher weighs two essays on a balance and points at the heavier, better one. A giant owl has watched thousands of these verdicts and now judges alone, flinging gold coins into the air for a robot pupil. The robot lunges for the coins, but a short chain ties it to its own frozen grey twin, so it can only stray so far.
image.zh: 老师把两篇作文放上天平，指着更重、更好的那篇。一只巨大的猫头鹰看过成千上万次这样的裁决，如今独自打分，把金币抛向空中给机器人学生。机器人扑向金币，可一条短铁链把它拴在自己那个冻住的灰色双胞胎身上，跑不了太远。

means.en: human preference comparisons: A is better than B
means.zh: 人类偏好比较：A 比 B 好

means.en: the reward model, trained on those comparisons
means.zh: 用这些比较训练出的奖励模型

means.en: the scalar reward that RL (PPO) maximises
means.zh: 强化学习（PPO）要最大化的标量奖励

thing.en: chain to the frozen grey twin
thing.zh: 拴住灰色双胞胎的铁链

means.en: KL penalty to the frozen SFT model, which limits reward hacking
means.zh: 对冻结 SFT 模型的 KL 惩罚，抑制奖励投机

summary.en: Train directly on preference pairs with a simple classification-style loss, skipping the separate reward model and the RL loop.
summary.zh: 直接在偏好对上用类似分类的简单损失训练，省掉单独的奖励模型和强化学习循环。

explain.en: Rafailov et al. (2023) showed that the KL-regularised RLHF objective has a closed-form optimal policy, π*(y|x) ∝ π_ref(y|x)·exp(r(x, y)/β). Inverting it writes the reward through the policy itself: r = β·log(π/π_ref) plus a term that cancels in comparisons. Substituting into the Bradley–Terry loss gives a loss on the policy directly: −log σ(β[log π(y_w|x)/π_ref(y_w|x) − log π(y_l|x)/π_ref(y_l|x)]). Training raises the chosen answer's likelihood relative to the reference and lowers the rejected one's. With no reward model to train and no sampling during training, DPO is simpler and more stable than PPO. It learns offline from a fixed dataset, and whether it matches well-tuned RLHF is still debated.
explain.zh: Rafailov 等人（2023）指出，带 KL 约束的 RLHF 目标有闭式最优策略：π*(y|x) ∝ π_ref(y|x)·exp(r(x, y)/β)。反过来，奖励可用策略本身表示：r = β·log(π/π_ref)，外加一个在比较中会抵消的项。代入 Bradley–Terry 损失，就得到直接作用于策略的损失：−log σ(β[log π(y_w|x)/π_ref(y_w|x) − log π(y_l|x)/π_ref(y_l|x)])。训练让被选回答相对参考模型的似然上升、被拒回答的下降。不用训练奖励模型，训练中也不必采样，所以比 PPO 简单、稳定。它从固定数据集离线学习；能否比得上调好的 RLHF，仍有争论。

example.en: Take β = 0.1. On one pair the policy has raised log π(y_w|x) 2 nats above the reference and lowered log π(y_l|x) by 1 nat. The margin is 0.1 × (2 − (−1)) = 0.3, so the loss is −log σ(0.3) ≈ 0.55. At the start, when π = π_ref, it was −log σ(0) = log 2 ≈ 0.69. Each step widens the gap between chosen and rejected.
example.zh: 取 β = 0.1。某个偏好对上，策略已把 log π(y_w|x) 比参考模型提高 2 奈特，把 log π(y_l|x) 降低 1 奈特。差距为 0.1 × (2 − (−1)) = 0.3，损失为 −log σ(0.3) ≈ 0.55；起初 π = π_ref 时损失是 −log σ(0) = log 2 ≈ 0.69。每一步都在拉大被选与被拒之间的差距。

image.en: The teacher hands a pupil two answers at once: a green ball for the chosen one, a red ball for the rejected one. On a classroom seesaw the green ball rides the rising end, while the pupil leans on the other end so the red ball tumbles off onto the floor. In the corner stands an empty bird cage: no reward-model owl needed here.
image.zh: 老师一次递给学生两个答案：绿球代表被选的，红球代表被拒的。教室里的跷跷板上，绿球随着一端高高翘起，学生压住另一端，红球滚落在地。角落里立着一只空鸟笼：这里用不着那只当奖励模型的猫头鹰。

means.en: raise the chosen answer's log-probability relative to the reference
means.zh: 相对参考模型，提高被选回答的对数概率

means.en: lower the rejected answer's log-probability
means.zh: 降低被拒回答的对数概率

means.en: the loss depends only on the margin between the pair
means.zh: 损失只取决于两者之间的差距

means.en: no separate reward model and no RL sampling loop
means.zh: 没有单独的奖励模型，也没有强化学习采样

means.en: a fixed, offline dataset of (chosen, rejected) pairs
means.zh: 固定的离线数据：（被选，被拒）偏好对

summary.en: Adapting and running big models on less hardware: low-rank adapters, fewer bits, smaller students.
summary.zh: 用更少的硬件微调和运行大模型：低秩适配器、更少的比特、更小的学生模型。

summary.en: Freeze the pretrained weights and train only a small low-rank update ΔW = BA, cutting trainable parameters by orders of magnitude.
summary.zh: 冻结预训练权重，只训练一个小小的低秩更新 ΔW = BA，可训练参数少几个数量级。

explain.en: Full fine-tuning updates every weight and must keep gradients and optimiser state for all of them. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) trains only a small set of new parameters, and LoRA (Hu et al., 2021) is the most popular method. For a frozen weight matrix W of shape d × k, LoRA learns ΔW = BA, with B of shape d × r and A of shape r × k, where the rank r (often 4 to 64) is much smaller than d and k. The layer computes Wx + (α/r)·BAx. B starts at zero, so training begins from the unchanged model. Afterwards BA can be merged into W with no extra inference latency, or kept as a small file and swapped per task. QLoRA puts LoRA on top of a 4-bit quantised base.
explain.zh: 全量微调要更新每个权重，还要为所有权重保存梯度和优化器状态。参数高效微调（PEFT）只训练一小撮新参数，最流行的是 LoRA（Hu 等，2021）。对形状为 d × k 的冻结权重 W，LoRA 学习 ΔW = BA，其中 B 为 d × r、A 为 r × k，秩 r（常取 4 到 64）远小于 d 和 k。该层计算 Wx + (α/r)·BAx。B 初始化为零，训练从原模型出发。训练后可把 BA 合并进 W，不增加推理延迟；也可存成小文件，按任务切换。QLoRA 则在 4 比特量化的基座上做 LoRA。

example.en: One 4096 × 4096 projection has 16,777,216 weights. With r = 8, LoRA trains B (4096 × 8) and A (8 × 4096): 8 × (4096 + 4096) = 65,536 parameters, 0.39% of the matrix. On GPT-3 175B the LoRA paper reported about 10,000 times fewer trainable parameters and a third of the GPU memory of full fine-tuning.
example.zh: 一个 4096 × 4096 的投影矩阵有 16,777,216 个权重。取 r = 8，LoRA 只训练 B（4096 × 8）和 A（8 × 4096）：8 × (4096 + 4096) = 65,536 个参数，仅占 0.39%。在 GPT-3 175B 上，LoRA 论文报告可训练参数约减少一万倍，显存降为全量微调的三分之一。

image.en: In the workshop a huge gear train is frozen solid, pale blue, with a heavy padlock hanging in front and blocks of ice on either side. A mechanic in a hard hat leaves it alone and tunes only two slim panels set beside it: a thin column of numbers and a thin row. Multiplied together they make a full-size correction, yet each holds only a handful of numbers.
image.zh: 工坊里，一组巨大的齿轮冻得发蓝，前面挂着沉重的挂锁，两旁堆着冰块。戴安全帽的技工根本不碰它，只调旁边两块细长的面板：一块是一竖列数字，一块是一横排数字。两者一乘就是整块大小的修正，各自却只有寥寥几个数。

means.en: the pretrained weights W stay frozen
means.zh: 预训练权重 W 保持冻结

means.en: B, shape d × r
means.zh: B，形状 d × r

means.en: A, shape r × k; the product BA is a rank-r update
means.zh: A，形状 r × k；乘积 BA 是秩 r 的更新

means.en: gradients flow only into A and B, so optimiser state is tiny
means.zh: 梯度只流向 A 和 B，优化器状态极小

summary.en: Store each weight in fewer bits, 16 → 8 → 4, to cut memory and speed up inference at a small cost in accuracy.
summary.zh: 用更少的比特存每个权重（16 → 8 → 4），省内存、提速度，代价是精度略降。

explain.en: Models are usually trained in 16-bit formats (BF16 or FP16), 2 bytes per weight. Quantisation maps each weight to a low-precision integer plus a shared scale: q = round(w / s), and w ≈ s·q when the weight is used. Scales are kept per channel or per small group (say 128 weights), so one outlier does not ruin the rest. Post-training methods such as GPTQ and AWQ quantise a finished model with a little calibration data; quantisation-aware training simulates the rounding during training. Decoding is mostly limited by memory bandwidth, since every weight is read for every new token, so fewer bytes per weight also means faster decoding. 8-bit weights are usually close to lossless; 4-bit costs a little accuracy, and below that losses grow quickly.
explain.zh: 模型通常以 16 位格式（BF16 或 FP16）训练，每个权重 2 字节。量化把每个权重映射成低精度整数加一个共享缩放因子：q = round(w / s)，使用时 w ≈ s·q。缩放因子按通道或按小组（如每 128 个权重）设置，免得一个离群值毁掉其余权重的精度。GPTQ、AWQ 等训练后量化方法用少量校准数据就能量化现成模型；量化感知训练则在训练中模拟取整。生成文本主要受内存带宽限制，每出一个 token 都要把全部权重读一遍，所以每个权重的字节越少，解码也越快。8 位通常几乎无损；4 位略有损失，再往下损失迅速变大。

example.en: A 7B-parameter model needs about 14 GB at 16 bits, 7 GB at 8 bits and 3.5 GB at 4 bits, plus a little for the scales. Absmax int8 with scale s = 1.27 / 127 = 0.01 maps the weights [0.52, −1.27, 0.034] to [52, −127, 3]; dequantised they become [0.52, −1.27, 0.03], an error of 0.004 on the last one.

image.en: Three identical elephants stand in a row in the workshop: the same animal at three sizes, a huge 16-bit one, a middle 8-bit one and a little 4-bit one. The little elephant rides proudly on an open laptop. A mechanic peers through a magnifying glass to check that the small ones still look like the big one, give or take a wrinkle.
image.zh: 工坊里一字排开三头一模一样的大象，同一头象的三种尺寸：最大的是 16 位，中等的是 8 位，最小的是 4 位。小象得意地站在一台打开的笔记本电脑上。技工举着放大镜比对：小象和大象还是一个样，顶多少了几道皱纹。

thing.en: the same elephant at three sizes

means.en: the same weights stored in 16, 8 and 4 bits
means.zh: 同一组权重，分别用 16、8、4 位存储

means.en: a 4-bit model fits on consumer hardware
means.zh: 4 位模型能装进普通电脑

means.en: rounding error: w ≈ s·round(w/s)
means.zh: 取整误差：w ≈ s·round(w/s)

means.en: measure the accuracy loss before shipping
means.zh: 上线前先测量精度损失

summary.en: Train a small student model to imitate a large teacher's outputs, keeping much of its quality at a fraction of the cost.
summary.zh: 训练小的学生模型模仿大教师模型的输出，以小得多的成本保住大部分能力。

explain.en: In knowledge distillation (Hinton et al., 2015) a small student learns from a large, already trained teacher. Instead of only the one correct label, the student matches the teacher's full output distribution, softened with a temperature T, by minimising the KL divergence between them, usually mixed with the ordinary loss on true labels. These soft targets carry 'dark knowledge': which wrong answers are nearly right. For language models the student can match the teacher's next-token probabilities at every position, or simply be fine-tuned on text the teacher generates (sequence-level distillation). Many small, fast models are made this way. Unlike quantisation, distillation produces a genuinely different, smaller network.
explain.zh: 知识蒸馏（Hinton 等，2015）让小的学生模型向训练好的大教师模型学习。学生不只学唯一正确的标签，而是拟合教师用温度 T 软化后的完整输出分布，即最小化两者的 KL 散度，通常再混合真实标签上的普通损失。这些软目标携带“暗知识”：哪些错误答案其实差不多对。对语言模型，学生可以在每个位置拟合教师的下一个 token 概率，也可以直接在教师生成的文本上微调（序列级蒸馏）。许多小而快的模型就是这样做出来的。与量化不同，蒸馏得到的是一个真正不同、更小的网络。

example.en: After 'I drank a cup of', the text says 'tea', so the hard label is tea = 1. The teacher predicts tea 0.55, coffee 0.40, water 0.05. Matching that distribution also tells the student that coffee was almost as good, which the single label hides. DistilBERT used distillation to make BERT 40% smaller while keeping about 97% of its language-understanding score and running 60% faster.
example.zh: “I drank a cup of”之后原文是“tea”，硬标签就是 tea = 1。教师给出 tea 0.55、coffee 0.40、water 0.05。学生拟合这个分布，还能学到 coffee 几乎同样合理，这是单个标签看不出的。DistilBERT 借助蒸馏把 BERT 缩小 40%，保留约 97% 的语言理解得分，速度快 60%。

image.en: A towering bronze robot, the teacher, stands beside a big bar chart of its guesses: a tall bar for tea, a fairly tall one for coffee, a stub for water. Next to it a small robot apprentice has drawn a smaller copy of exactly the same chart, the whole shape and not just the tallest bar. Between them sits a giant cup of tea.
image.zh: 高大的青铜机器人老师站在一张大柱状图旁，图上是它的猜测：tea 的柱子高，coffee 的也不矮，water 只有一小截。旁边的小机器人学徒照着画了一张小一号的图，形状一模一样：学的是整个分布，而不只是最高那根柱子。两者之间摆着一只巨大的茶杯。

means.en: the teacher: a large trained model
means.zh: 教师：训练好的大模型

means.en: the student: a smaller, faster model
means.zh: 学生：更小更快的模型

thing.en: the same chart, big and small
thing.zh: 一大一小同样的柱状图

means.en: match the teacher's full distribution (soft targets) by minimising KL
means.zh: 最小化 KL，拟合教师的完整分布（软目标）

means.en: dark knowledge: which wrong answers are nearly right
means.zh: 暗知识：哪些错误答案差不多对

means.en: the hard label: the token that actually came next
means.zh: 硬标签：实际出现的下一个 token

summary.en: What happens after training: picking tokens one at a time, serving many users quickly, and spending extra computation at answer time to reason better.
summary.zh: 训练之后的事：一次挑一个 token，又快又省地服务大量用户，以及在作答时多花算力把问题想透。

summary.en: The model only outputs probabilities; a decoding rule turns them into actual tokens, one at a time.
summary.zh: 模型只给出概率，解码规则把概率变成真正的 token，一次一个。

summary.en: Generate one token at a time: pick from the model's prediction, append the token to the input, and repeat until a stop token.
summary.zh: 一次生成一个 token：从预测中选出一个，接到输入末尾，再重复，直到遇到停止符。

explain.en: A language model only predicts the distribution of the next token. To produce a reply, the runtime loops: run the model on the sequence so far, pick a token with a decoding rule (greedy, sampling and so on), append it, and run again. Each output becomes part of the next input, which is what autoregressive means. Generation stops at a special end-of-sequence token, a stop string or a length limit. The loop is inherently sequential: token 50 cannot be computed before token 49 is known, so latency grows with the length of the answer. The prompt itself is processed in one parallel pass, and the KV cache avoids recomputing earlier positions at each step. Errors compound too: an early bad token conditions everything after it.
explain.zh: 语言模型只会预测下一个 token 的分布。要生成回复，运行时得循环：在当前序列上运行模型，用某种解码规则（贪心、采样等）选出一个 token，接到末尾，再运行一次。每个输出都成为下一步的输入，这就是“自回归”。遇到特殊的结束符、停止串或长度上限时停止。这个循环本质上是串行的：第 49 个 token 没出来，第 50 个就算不了，所以延迟随回答长度增长。提示本身可以一次并行处理，KV 缓存则免去每步重算前面的位置。错误还会累积：早期一个坏 token 会影响之后的一切。

example.en: Prompt 'The sky is'. Step 1: the model predicts ' blue' (probability 0.62); append it. Step 2: on 'The sky is blue' it predicts '.'; append. Step 3: it predicts the end-of-sequence token, so generation stops. At 50 ms per step, a 400-token answer takes about 400 × 0.05 = 20 seconds, which is why replies are streamed token by token.
example.zh: 提示“The sky is”。第 1 步：模型预测“ blue”（概率 0.62），接上。第 2 步：在“The sky is blue”上预测“.”，接上。第 3 步：预测出结束符，于是停止。若每步 50 毫秒，400 个 token 的回答约需 400 × 0.05 = 20 秒，所以回复通常逐个 token 流式输出。

image.en: A giant slot machine shows a single word on its reels: 'blue'. A gambler in a top hat pulls the lever again and again, and each pull pays out exactly one coin-word. The coins ride a conveyor belt in front of the machine, and a big curved arrow carries them back up into the coin slot before the next pull. At the end of the belt a traffic light has just turned red: the stop token.
image.zh: 一台巨大的老虎机，转轴上只显示一个词：“blue”。戴礼帽的赌客一次又一次拉下拉杆，每拉一次只吐出一枚“词币”。硬币顺着机器前的传送带走，一支弯弯的大箭头又把它们送回投币口，供下一次拉杆。传送带尽头的红绿灯刚刚变红：停止符到了。

means.en: the model: one forward pass gives one next-token distribution
means.zh: 模型：一次前向传播给出一个下一 token 分布

means.en: exactly one new token per step
means.zh: 每步只生成一个 token

thing.en: curved arrow back into the slot

means.en: each output is appended and becomes input
means.zh: 每个输出都被接上，成为下一步的输入

means.en: stop at the end-of-sequence token or a length limit
means.zh: 遇到结束符或长度上限就停

summary.en: Greedy decoding always takes the single most likely token; beam search keeps the k most likely partial sequences and can find a better whole.
summary.zh: 贪心解码每步只取最可能的 token；束搜索保留 k 条最可能的部分序列，可能找到整体更好的结果。

explain.en: Greedy decoding takes argmax p(token | prefix) at each step. It is fast and deterministic but short-sighted: a token that looks best now can lead to a worse sequence overall. Beam search keeps the k best partial sequences (the beam width), extends each by every possible token, scores the candidates by total log-probability and keeps the top k again. Because longer sequences accumulate more negative log-probability, scores are usually length-normalised. Beam search suits tasks with one right answer, such as translation or speech recognition. For open-ended writing both methods tend to produce bland, repetitive loops, because the most probable text is not the most human-like; sampling or repetition penalties are used instead.
explain.zh: 贪心解码每一步取 argmax p(token | 前缀)。它快且确定，但目光短浅：眼下最好的 token 可能把整句带到更差的地方。束搜索保留 k 条最好的部分序列（束宽），用所有可能的 token 扩展每一条，按累计对数概率打分，再留下前 k 条。序列越长，累计的负对数概率越多，所以分数通常按长度归一化。束搜索适合答案唯一的任务，如翻译和语音识别。对开放式写作，两者都容易写出平淡、重复打转的文字，因为概率最高的文本并不最像人写的，这时改用采样或重复惩罚。

example.en: After 'The', suppose p(nice) = 0.5 and p(dog) = 0.4. Next, p(woman | The nice) = 0.4 at best, but p(has | The dog) = 0.9. Greedy picks 'nice' and ends with 'The nice woman' at 0.5 × 0.4 = 0.20. Beam search with k = 2 keeps both branches and finds 'The dog has' at 0.4 × 0.9 = 0.36.
example.zh: 在“The”之后，设 p(nice) = 0.5，p(dog) = 0.4。接下来 p(woman | The nice) 最多 0.4，而 p(has | The dog) = 0.9。贪心选“nice”，得到“The nice woman”，概率 0.5 × 0.4 = 0.20。束宽 k = 2 的束搜索保留两个分支，找到“The dog has”，概率 0.4 × 0.9 = 0.36。

image.en: At a fork in the casino carpet a signpost reads 'nice | dog'. On the 'nice' side lies a huge gold coin, and a gambler in a top hat sprints for it, though only a small copper coin waits beyond. The 'dog' side starts with a smaller silver coin but ends at an open treasure chest. A scout with a lantern has kept both paths lit and points at the chest; a second lantern still glows on the other path.
image.zh: 赌场地毯上有个岔路口，路牌写着“nice | dog”。“nice”这边躺着一枚巨大的金币，戴礼帽的赌客拔腿冲过去，再往前却只有一枚小铜币。“dog”那边起头只是一枚小些的银币，尽头却是一只敞开的宝箱。提灯的侦察员让两条路都亮着，正指着宝箱；另一条路上还亮着第二盏灯。

thing.en: gambler sprinting for the big coin

means.en: greedy: take the most likely token at every step
means.zh: 贪心：每步取最可能的 token

means.en: beam width k = 2: keep the k best partial sequences
means.zh: 束宽 k = 2：保留 k 条最好的部分序列

means.en: the best whole sequence (0.36) starts with a less likely token
means.zh: 整体最优的序列（0.36）从次优的 token 开始

means.en: every step branches over the vocabulary
means.zh: 每一步都在词表上分叉

summary.en: Divide the logits by T before the softmax: T < 1 sharpens the distribution, T > 1 flattens it, and T → 0 becomes greedy.
summary.zh: 在 softmax 之前把 logits 除以 T：T < 1 让分布更尖，T > 1 让分布更平，T → 0 就是贪心。

explain.en: Sampling draws the next token from p_i = exp(z_i / T) / Σ_j exp(z_j / T), where z are the logits and T > 0 is the temperature. T = 1 uses the model's own distribution. Lower T exaggerates the gaps between logits and piles probability onto the top tokens, so output becomes predictable and repetitive; as T → 0 it turns into greedy decoding. Higher T shrinks the gaps toward a uniform distribution, so output becomes varied and then incoherent. The ranking of tokens never changes, only how strongly the top is preferred. Low temperatures suit code, extraction and factual answers; higher ones suit brainstorming. The name comes from the Boltzmann distribution of statistical physics, where temperature plays exactly this role.
explain.zh: 采样时下一个 token 按 p_i = exp(z_i / T) / Σ_j exp(z_j / T) 抽取，z 是 logits，T > 0 是温度。T = 1 就是模型原本的分布。T 越低，logits 之间的差距被放大，概率堆到最前面几个 token 上，输出可预测、易重复；T → 0 时退化为贪心解码。T 越高，差距缩小，分布趋于均匀，输出更多样，再高就语无伦次。token 的排序始终不变，变的只是对第一名偏爱得有多强。写代码、抽取信息和事实问答宜用低温，头脑风暴宜用高温。这个名字来自统计物理的玻尔兹曼分布，温度在那里起的正是同样的作用。

example.en: Logits [2, 1, 0]. At T = 1 the softmax gives [0.67, 0.24, 0.09]. At T = 0.5 the logits become [4, 2, 0] and the probabilities [0.87, 0.12, 0.02]. At T = 2 they become [1, 0.5, 0] and the probabilities [0.51, 0.31, 0.19]. The order never changes; only the sharpness does.

image.en: A giant thermometer stands in the middle of the casino floor. On the cold side a die is frozen onto a block of ice, the same face up every time. On the hot side a brazier blazes and red dice tumble in every direction, one of them still hopping. A croupier beside the ice points at the scale: she decides how wild the game will be.

summary.en: Cut off the unreliable tail before sampling: keep the k most likely tokens, or the smallest set whose probabilities add up to p.
summary.zh: 采样前先砍掉不可靠的长尾：只留概率最高的 k 个 token，或累计概率达到 p 的最小集合。

explain.en: Pure sampling now and then picks a token from the long tail of unlikely options, and one bad token can derail the rest of the text. Truncation prevents this. Top-k keeps the k most probable tokens, zeroes the rest, renormalises and samples. Its weakness is the fixed k: when the model is confident, k = 50 still admits junk; when it is unsure, k = 5 cuts off good options. Top-p, or nucleus sampling (Holtzman et al., 2019), keeps the smallest set of top tokens whose cumulative probability reaches p, so the set adapts: a few tokens when the distribution is peaked, many when it is flat. Both are usually combined with a temperature. A newer variant, min-p, keeps tokens whose probability is at least a fixed fraction of the top one's.
explain.zh: 纯采样偶尔会从长尾里抽出很不可能的 token，一个坏 token 就能让后文跑偏。截断可以避免这一点。Top-k 只保留概率最高的 k 个 token，其余置零，重新归一化后采样。它的缺点是 k 固定：模型很有把握时，k = 50 仍会放进垃圾；拿不准时，k = 5 又会砍掉好选项。Top-p 即核采样（Holtzman 等，2019），保留累计概率达到 p 的最小一组高概率 token，集合大小随分布自适应：分布尖时只剩几个，分布平时留下很多。两者通常与温度配合。较新的 min-p 则保留概率不低于第一名某个固定比例的 token。

example.en: Next-token probabilities: A 0.50, B 0.20, C 0.15, D 0.10, E 0.05. Top-k with k = 2 keeps A and B, renormalised to 0.71 and 0.29. Top-p with p = 0.8 adds tokens until the total reaches 0.8 (0.50, 0.70, 0.85), so it keeps A, B and C, renormalised to 0.59, 0.24 and 0.18. D and E can never be drawn.
example.zh: 下一个 token 的概率：A 0.50、B 0.20、C 0.15、D 0.10、E 0.05。k = 2 的 top-k 保留 A、B，归一化为 0.71、0.29。p = 0.8 的 top-p 依次累加直到达到 0.8（0.50、0.70、0.85），于是保留 A、B、C，归一化为 0.59、0.24、0.18。D 和 E 永远抽不到。

summary.en: Running models fast and cheaply for many users: caching, context limits, batching and drafting.
summary.zh: 为大量用户又快又省地运行模型：缓存、上下文上限、批处理和草稿加速。

summary.en: Keep the keys and values of past tokens in memory, so each new token computes only its own and attends to the stored ones.
summary.zh: 把过去 token 的键和值留在内存里，每个新 token 只算自己的那份，再去关注已存的。

explain.en: In a decoder, the key and value vectors of earlier tokens do not change when a new token arrives, thanks to the causal mask. Without a cache, every decoding step would recompute them for the whole prefix. The KV cache stores them per layer and per head: each step computes q, k and v only for the newest token, appends k and v to the cache, and attends over everything stored. Each step then costs time linear in the context length instead of re-running the whole prefix. The price is memory: the cache grows with context length and batch size, and for long contexts or big batches it can outgrow the weights. Grouped-query and multi-query attention share keys and values across heads to shrink it, and paged allocation (vLLM) avoids fragmentation.
explain.zh: 在解码器里，由于因果掩码，新 token 到来时前面 token 的键（key）和值（value）向量不会改变。没有缓存的话，每步解码都要为整个前缀重算一遍。KV 缓存按层、按头把它们存起来：每一步只为最新的 token 计算 q、k、v，把 k、v 追加进缓存，再对所有已存内容做注意力。这样每步的开销与上下文长度成线性，不必把整个前缀重跑。代价是内存：缓存随上下文长度和批大小增长，长上下文或大批量时甚至超过权重。分组查询（GQA）和多查询注意力让多个头共享键值来缩小缓存，分页分配（vLLM）则避免碎片。

example.en: A Llama-2-7B-sized model has 32 layers and a hidden size of 4096 split over 32 heads. In 16-bit precision each token stores K and V in every layer: 2 × 32 × 4096 × 2 bytes = 524,288 bytes, or 0.5 MiB. A 4,096-token context needs 2 GiB of cache per sequence, and a batch of 8 such sequences needs 16 GiB, more than the 13.5 GB of weights.
example.zh: Llama-2-7B 规模的模型有 32 层，隐藏维度 4096，分成 32 个头。用 16 位精度，每个 token 在每层都要存 K 和 V：2 × 32 × 4096 × 2 字节 = 524,288 字节，即 0.5 MiB。4096 个 token 的上下文每条序列需要 2 GiB 缓存，8 条这样的序列就要 16 GiB，比 13.5 GB 的权重还大。

A robot arm at the cauldron prepares only the newest ingredient, sets one fresh pair of jars at the end of the rows, and dips into all the old jars instead of chopping everything again. The rows already reach the edge of the stage.

summary.en: The most tokens a model can take in at once, prompt and answer together. Longer windows cost more and are not used evenly.
summary.zh: 模型一次能接收的最多 token 数（提示与回答合计）。窗口越长越贵，利用也并不均匀。

explain.en: The context window is the maximum sequence length, prompt plus generated tokens, that a model can process at once. It is limited by the lengths seen in training, by the position scheme and by cost: during prefill, attention compute grows quadratically with length, and the KV cache grows linearly. Anything outside the window is simply invisible to the model, so long chats and documents must be truncated, summarised or retrieved selectively. A big window is not the same as good use of it: Liu et al. (2023) found that models answer best when the relevant passage sits at the start or end of the context and worst when it sits in the middle, the 'lost in the middle' effect. Windows have grown from about 2,000 tokens to hundreds of thousands.
explain.zh: 上下文窗口是模型一次能处理的最大序列长度，提示加生成的 token 都算在内。它受训练时见过的长度、位置编码方式和成本限制：预填充时注意力计算随长度平方增长，KV 缓存随长度线性增长。窗口外的内容对模型来说根本不存在，所以长对话和长文档必须截断、摘要或有选择地检索。窗口大不等于用得好：Liu 等人（2023）发现，相关段落位于上下文开头或结尾时模型答得最好，位于中间时最差，即“迷失在中间”。窗口已从约 2000 个 token 增长到几十万。

example.en: A 128k-token window holds roughly 300 pages of English: 128,000 tokens × about 0.75 words per token = 96,000 words, at about 300 words per page. Doubling a prompt from 64k to 128k tokens roughly quadruples the attention compute of prefill and doubles the KV cache. In multi-document QA, moving the key document from first place to the middle of 20 documents lowered accuracy noticeably.
example.zh: 128k token 的窗口约能装 300 页英文：128,000 个 token × 每 token 约 0.75 个词 = 96,000 词，每页约 300 词。提示从 64k 增加到 128k，预填充的注意力计算约变为 4 倍，KV 缓存变为 2 倍。在多文档问答实验中，把关键文档从 20 篇中的第一篇挪到中间，准确率明显下降。

image.en: Two kitchen tables are pushed end to end and covered with a long row of cups: every token the model can see. Spotlights blaze on both ends of the row, while the middle cups sit in shadow, where a cat quietly laps from one of them and nobody notices. Past the far right end, one more cup has dropped to the floor: it no longer fits in the window.
image.zh: 两张厨房桌子首尾相接，上面摆着长长一排杯子：这是模型能看到的全部 token。两盏聚光灯照亮队伍的两端，中间的杯子在阴影里，一只猫悄悄舔着其中一杯，没人发现。最右端之外，又有一只杯子掉到了地上：窗口已经装不下它了。

thing.en: long row of cups on the tables

means.en: the context window: every token the model sees at once
means.zh: 上下文窗口：模型一次能看到的全部 token

means.zh: 开头和结尾的信息利用得最好

summary.en: Serve many requests in each forward pass: one read of the weights per step is shared by the whole batch, raising throughput at some cost in latency.
summary.zh: 每次前向传播同时服务多个请求：每步只读一遍权重、全批共用，吞吐量上升，延迟略增。

explain.en: Serving has two phases. Prefill processes the whole prompt in one parallel pass; it is compute-bound and sets the time to first token. Decode then produces one token per step for each sequence; it is memory-bound, because every step streams all the weights from GPU memory to produce very little output. Putting many sequences into each step reuses that single read, so tokens per second rise almost linearly with batch size until compute or KV-cache memory runs out, while each user's per-token latency rises somewhat. Static batching waits for the slowest request in the batch. Continuous (in-flight) batching, introduced by Orca and used in vLLM, adds and removes requests at every step, so a finished sequence's slot is refilled at once.
explain.zh: 推理服务分两个阶段。预填充（prefill）一次并行处理整个提示，受算力限制，决定首个 token 的等待时间。解码（decode）随后每步为每条序列生成一个 token，受内存带宽限制：每一步都要把全部权重从显存读一遍，却只产出很少的结果。把许多序列放进同一步，就能共用这一次读取，每秒 token 数几乎随批大小线性增长，直到算力或 KV 缓存耗尽；代价是每个用户的单 token 延迟有所上升。静态批处理要等批里最慢的请求。连续批处理（Orca 提出，vLLM 采用）每一步都可加入和移除请求，一条序列结束，空位立刻补上。

example.en: A 7B model in 16-bit has about 14 GB of weights. On a GPU with about 2 TB/s of memory bandwidth, one decode step needs at least 14 GB ÷ 2 TB/s = 7 ms just to read them: about 140 tokens/s for a single user. With 32 short requests in the batch, a step costs only a little more, so throughput nears 32 × 140 ≈ 4,500 tokens/s; long contexts add KV-cache reads and pull this down.
example.zh: 16 位的 7B 模型约有 14 GB 权重。在显存带宽约 2 TB/s 的 GPU 上，光读一遍权重，每个解码步就至少要 14 GB ÷ 2 TB/s = 7 毫秒：单个用户约每秒 140 个 token。批里放 32 条短请求，每步只多花一点时间，吞吐量接近 32 × 140 ≈ 4500 token/秒；上下文越长，读 KV 缓存越多，吞吐量越低。

image.en: Five cauldrons bubble in an arc around a chef, who gives every pot one stir per round in a single sweep. On the right, a waiter carries off a finished dish the moment it is ready; on the left, an assistant is already pushing in a fresh pot whose ingredients were all chopped in one go. Nobody waits for the slowest soup.
image.zh: 五口大锅围成一道弧，咕嘟冒泡，中间的厨师每一轮一圈搅过所有锅。右边，服务员在一道菜做好的瞬间就把它端走；左边，帮厨已经推来一口新锅，里面的食材一次全切好了。谁也不用等最慢的那锅汤。

means.zh: 一起解码的一批序列

means.en: each decode step reads the weights once for the whole batch
means.zh: 每个解码步读一遍权重，全批共用

thing.en: dish carried off, new pot pushed in

means.zh: 连续批处理：请求每步都可加入或离开

means.zh: 预填充：整个提示一次并行处理

summary.en: A small draft model guesses several tokens ahead and the big model checks them all in one pass: faster output, exactly the same distribution.
summary.zh: 小的草稿模型先猜几个 token，大模型一次前向传播全部验证：出字更快，输出分布却完全不变。

explain.en: Large-model decoding is slow: every token needs a full pass, mostly spent reading weights. Speculative decoding (Leviathan et al.; Chen et al., 2023) lets a cheap draft model q propose γ tokens in a row. The target model p then scores all γ positions in a single parallel forward pass. From left to right, each draft token x is accepted with probability min(1, p(x)/q(x)). At the first rejection, a replacement is sampled from the leftover distribution, proportional to max(0, p − q), and the rest of the draft is dropped; if all are accepted, the target adds one extra token for free. This rule guarantees that the output follows exactly the target model's distribution. The speed-up, often 2–3×, depends on how often the draft agrees with the target.
explain.zh: 大模型解码慢，因为每个 token 都要完整跑一遍，而时间大多花在读权重上。投机解码（Leviathan 等；Chen 等，2023）让便宜的草稿模型 q 连续提出 γ 个 token，目标模型 p 再用一次并行前向传播给这 γ 个位置全部打分。从左到右，每个草稿 token x 以概率 min(1, p(x)/q(x)) 被接受。一旦被拒，就从正比于 max(0, p − q) 的剩余分布里重抽一个替代，草稿其余部分作废；若全部接受，目标模型还白送一个 token。这条规则保证输出严格服从目标模型的分布。加速比常为 2–3 倍，取决于草稿与目标模型一致的频率。

example.en: The draft proposes 4 tokens: 'the cat sat on'. One pass of the target model accepts 'the cat sat' and rejects 'on', resampling 'down' from the leftover distribution, so that pass yields 4 tokens instead of 1. A draft token with q(x) = 0.6 and p(x) = 0.3 is kept with probability 0.3 / 0.6 = 0.5; one with p(x) ≥ q(x) is always kept.
example.zh: 草稿模型提出 4 个 token：“the cat sat on”。目标模型跑一遍，接受“the cat sat”，拒绝“on”，并从剩余分布里重抽出“down”：这一遍得到 4 个 token，而不是 1 个。若某草稿 token 的 q(x) = 0.6、p(x) = 0.3，它以 0.3 / 0.6 = 0.5 的概率被保留；若 p(x) ≥ q(x)，则一定保留。

Three cream cakes pass and stay; the fourth came out burnt black and now sits in the slop bucket, and in its place the chef has set down a golden cake of his own. Four cakes for the price of one tasting.

means.zh: 目标模型一次并行验证全部草稿 token

means.zh: 各以 min(1, p/q) 的概率被接受
